title: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series

messages.subject: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is good to hear from you again. For this work, we can offer a price of €36.00 per unit. We have our CNC machines ready and look forward to putting this job onto the shop floor for you. 

Let me know if this works for you so we can get started soon.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. We have already taken that index change data into account. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. I can drop our price to €31.50 for the 30-day payment and 28-day lead time. We need the cash flowing, so please make sure invoices are paid on time if we do this price. We can offer a price of €31.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: Pump shaft HX (part:320070) - revised packages
messages.body:
Hallo Herr Dralveck,

thank you for your revised quote and for checking our data so quickly. A valid competing offer is EUR 31 per unit (offer:70250-1); please improve your complete package.

You mentioned that cash flow matters to you. Two of the attached packages therefore use 14-day payment, so your invoices are settled quickly and reliably. All three packages cover 4200 pc per year over 24 months, delivered DAP Hollerau.

Could a cheaper variant lower your cost, for example on material grade or tolerances for drawing rev. B? Please make your best complete package your standing offer.

Gruß
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Pump shaft HX (part:320070) - revised packages
messages.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have clarified this internally and can move further on the price. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We did not know that - a fair point. 

Thanks for offering the 14-day payment, that really helps us keep the cash moving so I can give you a better price. I can do €28.50 per piece if we lock in the 14 days payment and 28 days lead time. My guys can look at the tolerances for rev. B to see if it saves time, but this price is for the current drawing.

Our current Angebot is a price of €28.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days.

From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 1.10 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.82 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.51 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

Gruß
